version: 0.4.5
tagline: Your party named from the first boss, and a boss card that stays on the boss.

## Fixed
- 👥 **Party members named from the first boss** of every dungeon, room members included, so every fight counts on the DPS boards
- 🙋 **Your own name instead of *You*** when the meter was started after you logged in
- 🎯 **The boss card stays on the boss** instead of jumping to its adds
- 💎 **Odyle shows the right amount** (0 when it's 0)
- 📍 **Teleport notice gone in dungeons:** it only shows while a monster really can't be identified
- ⏱ **Enrage countdown for everyone:** an old names file in your data folder no longer hides it

## New
- 🎨 **New event and Odyle icons** on the next-events line, the alert banners and the footer
